hook_text: A bungee jumper falls from one of the highest bridges in the world. What brings her back up?
clip_script: Bloukrans Bridge. She dives. Faster, faster. The cord stretches, slows her, stops her. Stored energy, packed into a stretched cord. Then: release! She shoots back up. Stored energy becomes movement energy. Same idea in a bow and arrow, a catapult, a wind-up car and a trampoline. Back in class: twist an elastic band inside a cotton reel. Let go. The tractor crawls across the floor. More twists? It goes further!
visual_style: Whiteboard bridge with a jumper on a stretchy cord, energy labels switching from movement to stored and back.
pacing: Big jump, energy swap explained, quick tour of toys, then the tractor race.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and build your own cotton-reel tractor.
